title: TLS: mimid terminates TLS itself (rustls, optional client certs) or takes the client cert from a configured trusted proxy
description: Both modes (Mark 2026-11-15). Forwarded-cert header accepted only from the configured proxy address. Needed by the mTLS mechanisms.
close_reason: Implemented: [tls] (mimid terminates TLS, client certs requested) and [trusted_proxy] (forwarded leaf from configured addresses only). ClientCertificate extension for .5/.6. 1346 tests pass. Not deployed: no host config uses it yet.
